newsitem.title: USA: White House aide sees progress in budget talks.
newsitem.headline: White House aide sees progress in budget talks.

text.p: White House economic adviser Gene Sperling said Thursday talks with congressional leaders on the budget have been making progress and that he thinks a deal is possible.
"We've made solid progress," Sperling told reporters following a speech to the Economic Strategy Institute.
He told reporters he thought a deal with the Republican-led Congress on a budget package that respects the ideals of the negotiators but brings spending into balance with revenues was "doable."
Sperling said a round of discussions that included Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin and Secretary of State Madeleine Albright would be held Thursday afternoon.
He said he thought there might be some further talks but said the upcoming Jewish Passover holiday would not allow negotiators to make a full court press at this time to strike a deal.
